2608.30924.title: TRIPPULSE: Multi-Agent Travel Planning with Review-Grounded Reasoning
2608.30924.paper_summary: Travel itinerary generation requires balancing strict spatio-temporal constraints with human preferences. Existing LLM-based planners mainly rely on structured attributes and pre- defined traveler personas, but real travel deci- sions are often shaped by reviews that reveal experiential factors such as comfort, safety, ser- vice quality, ambiance, crowding, and hidden risks absent from structured databases. Incor- porating such review information is therefore critical to realistic, user-centric itinerary gen- eration. We propose TRIPPULSE1, a multi- agent framework for review-grounded travel planning. Instead of relying on a monolithic planner (and face context and reasoning bot- tlenecks), TRIPPULSE2 decomposes itinerary generation into specialized agents (each op- erating over localized contexts) for accom- modations, transportation, meals, attractions, and events, coordinated through a global or- chestrator with scheduling mechanisms that enforce temporal and budget feasibility. We augment TRIPCRAFT with 100K+ real-world reviews and introduce Review-Grounded Per- sona Alignment (RGPA), an LLM-as-a-Judge metric for evaluating alignment with human- centric travel experiences. Experiments across multiple trip durations and diverse proprietary and open-source models show that TRIPPULSE maintains strong constraint satisfaction while generating more personalized and experien- tially grounded itineraries.
2608.30924.paper_summary_zh: 旅行行程生成需要在嚴格的時空限制與人類偏好之間取得平衡。現有的基於大型語言模型（LLM）的規劃者主要依賴結構化屬性和預定義的旅客角色，但實際的旅行決策往往受到評論的影響，這些評論揭示了如舒適度、安全性、服務質量、氛圍、擁擠程度和結構化數據庫中缺失的潛在風險等體驗因素。因此，納入這些評論信息對於現實且以用戶為中心的行程生成至關重要。我們提出了TRIPPULSE1，一個基於評論的旅行規劃的多代理框架。TRIPPULSE2不依賴單一的規劃者（以避免上下文和推理瓶頸），而是將行程生成分解為專門的代理（每個代理在本地上下文中運作），涵蓋住宿、交通、餐飲、景點和活動，並通過一個全球協調者進行協調，該協調者擁有強制執行時間和預算可行性的調度機制。我們用超過10萬條真實世界的評論增強了TRIPCRAFT，並引入了基於評論的角色對齊（RGPA），這是一種作為評判者的LLM指標，用於評估與以人為中心的旅行體驗的一致性。針對多個旅行時長和多樣的專有及開源模型的實驗顯示，TRIPPULSE在生成更具個性化和體驗基礎的行程的同時，保持了強大的約束滿足能力。
